name: Alex Huston Fischer
bio: Alex Huston Fischer is a writer and director recognized for his work in independent film, frequently collaborating with Eleanor Wilson. He is best known for the science fiction comedy Save Yourselves! (2020) and the fantasy project Wicker (2026), both of which premiered at the Sundance Film Festival.

credits.title: Wicker
credits.overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

credits.title: Save Yourselves!
credits.overview: A young Brooklyn couple head upstate to disconnect from their phones and reconnect with themselves. Cut off from their devices, they miss the news that the planet is under attack.

credits.title: Snowy Bing Bongs Across the North Star Combat Zone
credits.overview: Dance-comedy trio Cocoon Central Dance lounges about, passes gas, and bursts into bizarre dance routines while navigating outer space interludes, doctor boners, and a '90s-style girl group meltdown.

credits.title: For Maya
credits.overview: The night before running a marathon for a good cause, two friends examine their lives, their fears, and the legacy they'll leave behind. And of course they carbo load.
